notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.content:
Since our last fest appearance, we've been deeply engrossed in enhancing the gaming experience for our players. Our team has been diligently working behind the scenes, dedicating ourselves to the development and expansion of the game. We are excited to announce that we have enriched the game with five additional maps. Each map boasts a unique set of adversaries, offering players diverse and refreshing gameplay experiences. As we approach the final stages of development, we are currently in the testing phase for the upcoming release. It is with great anticipation that we share these developments with our community, and we eagerly look forward to bringing you an even more immersive and engaging game.

Here are some exclusive sneak peeks at what we've been crafting:


 Eternal Vigil Map: This map retains its original, enigmatic darkness, ensuring the same intense atmosphere as before.
 Summit: Embark on an icy adventure to dominate the frigid expanse of Summit, our most extensive map to date, where the chill of the snow is as much your adversary as the foes that inhabit it.
 Frozen River: A wintry battlefield set upon a treacherous frozen river. Here, players stand their ground against endless waves of enemies, making for a relentlessly dynamic combat experience.
 Ruined Tomb: One of our most distinctive maps, located within the ancient confines of an Egyptian pyramid. Navigate through history as you battle your way out of these storied ruins.
 Rocky Passage: A map set in a deserted canyon mining town, where players must fend off relentless assaults from their adversaries, emphasizing strategy and fortitude.
 Forsaken Lands: Venture into the infernal depths of the Forsaken Lands, a map where the strongest enemies reside, and the pressure is unyielding.


Additionally, we're thrilled to unveil the complete overhaul of Shady Mario. This character now introduces a shop feature along with enchantments and upgrades for your items. We've refined the original enchant system from our demo into a more robust upgrade mechanism, while our revamped enchant system remains shrouded in mystery, promising to surprise and engage players in new ways.

We're brimming with updates, but we'll keep some secrets close to our chest for now. Stay tuned for more thrilling revelations as we progress toward our release.

notes.title: Welcome Tori, the mighty one!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rm_gwxZqAb8;full][/previewyoutube]

Lurking in the shadows with a cunning glint in her eyes, Tori the kobold is a menacing sight on the battlefield. Her small stature and agile movements make her an elusive and dangerous opponent. Equipped with a sharp hatchet and a sturdy wooden shield, she is a whirlwind of destruction, focused solely on her target: the precious crystal.

Tori combines speed and strategy, her armor lightweight yet effective, allowing her to navigate the battlefield with ease. Her shield, adorned with symbols of her clan, is not just for defense; it's a badge of honor, representing her skills and cunning in battle.

But what drives this stealthy saboteur? Why is she so intent on shattering the crystal?

Join us to unravel the mysteries of Tori! Delve into her story, face her sneaky tactics, and discover the secrets behind the most elusive hatchet in the shadowed groves. Sharpen your senses, for Tori the Shadow Striker is on the prowl! 🪓

Get ready to defend against this swift and stealthy foe in the shadowed groves. Before you confront Tori the Shadow Striker, here’s a sneak peek into the stats that make this kobold a unique challenge:


 Health: Small but resilient, Tori's health is deceptive. She may not withstand many hits, but she's tricky to catch.
 Resistance: Tori is nimble, dodging physical attacks with ease. However, her small size makes her vulnerable to area-of-effect spells.
 Speed: Earning the title 'Shadow Striker' for her quickness, Tori can dart across the battlefield, making her a slippery target to contain.
 Damage: With her hatchet, Tori inflicts swift, sharp blows. While not the strongest, her attacks are quick and can rapidly whittle down defenses.
 Behavior: Cunning and relentless, Tori targets the crystal with single-minded determination, often taking the most unexpected paths to reach her goal.

notes.title: Introducing: Gorrim, the Tower Tumbler
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5RwCffIC9Rc;full][/previewyoutube]

Emerging from the depths of the ancient mines, Gorrim’s foreboding figure casts a shadow that darkens even the most vibrant of terrains. The clink of the nails on his gargantuan bat echoes with every step, announcing his presence long before you see him. With every swing of his weapon, entire fortresses have been reduced to rubble, earning him the title of the "Tower Tumbler."

Despite his lumbering pace, his impact is colossal. The armor draped over his massive frame bears the scars of countless battles, each dent and scratch narrating a tale of destruction and power. Adorned with heavy leg guards and a chest plate inscribed with runes of the ancients, Gorrim stands as an unyielding bulwark, ready to face any adversary head-on.

Yet, what propels the Tower Tumbler? What ancient grudges or ambitions does he harbor?

Join us in unveiling Gorrim’s origins! Delve into his mythos, take on his challenges, and learn of the tales surrounding the most fearsome bat in the Obsidian Valleys. Ready your defenses, for the Tower Tumbler approaches! 🦇

As you brace yourself for the impending clash against Gorrim the Tower Tumbler, here's a glimpse into the attributes that cement him as a terror on the battlefield:


 Health: Gorrim’s massive structure isn’t just for show. His health pool is vast, capable of enduring wave after wave of relentless attacks.
 Resistance: Gorrim's thick skin and ancient armor make him nearly impervious to physical attacks. However, his size makes him slightly more vulnerable to magical incantations.
 Speed: While his pace might be slow, each step covers a great distance. Underestimating his reach could be your last mistake.
 Damage: The huge bat, studded with nails, ensures that Gorrim deals damage that's nothing short of cataclysmic, especially to structures. Magic isn't his forte, but when it comes to raw power, few can match him.
 Behavior: Gorrim is drawn to towering structures, making a beeline for them and bringing them down with earth-shattering force. His singular focus is destruction; once he targets a tower, its fate is almost sealed.

notes.title: Introducing: Burzak, the Swift Striker!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Jm4w1p8TQQ8;full][/previewyoutube]


Standing tall and intimidating, Burzak's silhouette is a stark contrast to the snow-capped mountains of his homeland. The mere sight of him evokes both awe and terror. His long limbs end in rapid strikes, each blow from his battle axe landing faster than the eye can follow. It's been said that storms seem to slow when compared to Burzak's relentless assault.

A unique blend of agility and power, his armor tells tales of his battle prowess and strategic mindset. While he dons basic armor across his torso, Burzak protects his arms with heavy steel bracers, a testament to his aggressive combat style which often finds him on the frontline, parrying blows and landing crushing counter-attacks.

But what drives the Swift Striker? Why does he roam the lands with such purpose?

Join us to find out more about Burzak! Dive into his lore, face his challenges, and uncover the true story behind the fastest axe in the Ashen Peaks. Ready your weapons, for the Swift Striker awaits! 🪓

Prepare to meet a formidable foe on the battlegrounds of the Ashen Peaks. Before you square off against Burzak the Swift Striker, we’re giving you a sneak peek into the stats that make this Orc a force to be reckoned with:


 Health: Towering above most, Burzak boasts a health pool that's as vast as the legends surrounding him. You'll find him difficult to take down, even when surrounded.
 Resistance: While his physical defenses may be lacking, Burzak’s ancestral ties grant him high resistance against magical attacks. It's said that the spirits of the Ashen Peaks shield him from arcane harm.
 Speed: Bearing the title of 'Swift Striker' is no mere flattery. Burzak moves with a speed that belies his size, making him a challenging target to pin down.
 Damage: Relying on the sheer power of his battle axe, Burzak deals devastating physical blows. However, do not expect him to wield much magical power; his strengths lie elsewhere.
 Behavior: With a fierce and determined mindset, Burzak targets the closest enemy, ensuring that no threat goes unchecked. His focus is unwavering; once he has you in his sights, there's little escape.

notes.title: Meet the Nameless
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3GE3tVK6FQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, dear community!

We're beyond thrilled to unveil a formidable new adversary soon to stalk the landscapes of our game. Meet the Nameless - a paradoxical being from the deepest chasms of an otherworldly realm, poised to challenge your every move.

About the Nameless:
The Nameless is not just another foe; it's a creature birthed from the fabric of obscurity. In an otherworldly realm, far from the well-trodden paths of Earth, the Nameless evolved. Its massive form, a testament to countless eons of evolution, stands as a reminder of a place where only the mightiest endure. Devoid of sight, it maneuvers through terrains guided solely by the luminous auras and energy from creatures of light. Drawn to brightness, not out of admiration but an innate desire to snuff it out, it is the embodiment of darkness challenging dawn.

Its formidable claws, not just instruments of war but extensions of its very soul, are meticulously honed to extinguish light, drawing vitality from every sliver of energy they grasp.

Stat Breakdown:

 Health: High
     Resistance: Average physical, average magical
     Speed: Fast
     Damage: High physical, very low magical
     Behavior: The Nameless locks onto the closest enemy, making sure no space stands as sanctuary against its reach.


Dive into the experience of its haunting silence, feel the tension as its shadows murmur, and brace yourself for its relentless advance. But be forewarned: once you're marked, escape might just be an illusion.

Gameplay Insights:
    
 Ambush Predator: With its swift motions and focus on the nearest enemy, the Nameless is the embodiment of the ambush predator. Always stay vigilant!
     Balanced Resistance: Its balanced resistance to both physical and magical onslaughts means you'll need a well-rounded strategy to fend off its aggression.
     Physical Dominance: Though its magical might is modest, don't be lulled into complacency. Its physical attacks are nothing short of devastating.


We're confident that the Nameless will offer a pulse-racing challenge for all players. We eagerly await your tales of encounters and the stratagems you employ against this shadowy menace. As always, our heartfelt gratitude for being an integral part of our community. Brace yourselves, strategize smartly, and may your lights never falter before the advancing gloom.

Warm regards,
Ember Eye Studio

notes.title: Meet the Goblins!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KeEYnmKYzmU;full][/previewyoutube]


 The goblin warrior is a well-known and feared foe on the outskirts of The Great Divide. Multiplying by the thousands, they pillage unprotected villages, leaving nothing but ruins. When fighting, their preferred strategy is to stay together in groups, as their primary strength lies within their numbers. When you face one, be prepared for a long, tiresome fight, as the horde is near.

Stats:

 Health: Very low
 Resistance: Low physical, very low magical
 Speed: Fast
 Damage: Average physical, very low magical
 Behavior: Focuses on the closest enemy.



The goblin race is not famous for its intelligence, but rare cases still exist. Taking advantage of ranged combat, the goblin archer utilizes the willingness to sacrifice of his brothers. Don't underestimate his vile tactics.

Health: Low

 Resistance: Average physical, low magical
 Speed: Average
 Damage: High physical, very low magical
 Behavior: Prefers to keep distance from the enemy.

notes.title: Meet the Werewolf
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4ptMn0if_c8;full][/previewyoutube]


The werewolf is a result of the obsession of the moon druids with transmutation magic. Constantly being forced to run away by pillagers, the druids decided to strengthen themselves with animalistic power. Though after the process of binding themselves with nature, they lose control of themselves and eventually must leave the tribe.


Stats:

 Health: Very high.
 Resistance: Low physical, high magical.
 Speed: Very fast.
 Damage: Very high physical, very low magical.
 Behavior: Targets the closest enemy.
